
{{alias}}( m )
    Computes the complete elliptic integral of the first kind for a
    single-precision floating-point number.

    Parameters
    ----------
    m: number
        Input value.

    Returns
    -------
    y: number
        Function value.

    Examples
    --------
    > var y = {{alias}}( 0.5 )
    ~1.854
    > y = {{alias}}( -1.0 )
    ~1.311
    > y = {{alias}}( 2.0 )
    NaN
    > y = {{alias}}( {{alias:@stdlib/constants/float32/pinf}} )
    NaN
    > y = {{alias}}( {{alias:@stdlib/constants/float32/ninf}} )
    NaN
    > y = {{alias}}( NaN )
    NaN

    See Also
    --------
